violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOUL ODOR EMANATING FROM GREASE TRAP IN FLOOR AT END OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REQUEST SERVICE AND EMAIL EHS COMPLETED SERVICE REPORT WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): GARLIC SAUCE ON PIZZA STATION PREP TOP WITHOUT 4 HOUR TIME DOCUMENTATION.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED 4 HOUR TIME LABEL ON GARLIC SAUC. EHS WILL FORWARD TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL DOCUMENTATION FOR GARLIC SAUCE AND PIZZA SAUCE TO PIC.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED UNLABELED SPRAY BOTTLES OF CHEMICALS - DEGREASER, ETC, ON SHELVING NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED LABELS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OILS, VINEGAR, WATER AND OTHER LIQUIDS NEAR COOK LINE WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY LABLES DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BASE OF BACK KITCHEN DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE INSTALL DOOR SWEEP ON OUTER BASE OF BACK KITCHEN DOOR TO SEAL GAPS. PAISANO'S (Inspection Date: 06/26/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Proper Temp
violations.observation: The following food item(s) was not reheated for hot holding to a sufficient temperature and/or time: OBSERVED REHEATED FOR HOT HOLDING MEATBALLS AT 131F IN STEAM WELL.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding shall be reheated to a minimum temperature of 165F for 15 seconds. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT MEATBALLS TO 165F OR ABOVE. STAFF REHEATED TO 187F DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the MOP SINK FAUCET WITH CHEMICAL CLEANING SYSTEM INSTALLED.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH INFORMATION ON APPROVED DEVICE TO INSTALL ON MOP SINK. PLEASE ORDER AND INSTALL WITHIN 3 DAYS. EMAIL EHS ONCE APPROVED BACK FLOW PROTECTION DEVICE IS INSTALLED.
